caption: A glass of water is set in front of a card printed with a straight vertical line, and the line seen through the glass looks shifted and wider.

sa.check: A card is printed with a straight vertical line.
A glass of water is set in front of it.
The line seen through the glass looks shifted and wider.
The line returns to normal when the glass is moved away.

pc.expect: The line appears displaced only behind the water-filled part of the glass and returns to normal when the glass is moved.
pc.fail: The line is displaced beside the glass; or it is unchanged behind the water; or it stays displaced after the glass is gone.

pc.expect: The card and its line are unchanged; the shift is an appearance.
pc.fail: The line on the card moves; or a second line is printed; or the card bends.

pc.expect: The water surface is level and the glass is rigid.
pc.fail: The water tilts and holds; or the glass warps; or the water goes opaque.

pc.expect: The card and the glass stay put unless moved by the hand.
pc.fail: The card slides; or the glass moves by itself; or the image shifts with both still.
The glass duplicates; or the card vanishes; or the glass passes through the card.

pc.expect: The card, the glass and the table stay the same.
pc.fail: The card changes colour; or the glass changes shape; or the table changes.

note: The hand is the minimal trigger; the person is not judged.
